- Type: Time (Minutes)

- Description: Agent Handoff Protocol — generic, pull-based inter-instance handoff
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/763
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/764
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/302
  
  Details:
  Designed and implemented a generic mechanism for autopilot instances (Sophia, Bionpact, future siblings) to hand off information without open bot-to-bot chat (Telegram flags that as a mandatory anti-loop-engineering risk neither instance handles) and without cross-instance write access to each other's private storage. Public agents/*.json registry (agentic_ai_context#764) + roadmap (agentic_ai_context#763) + a single dedicated shared agent_handoffs repo every registered agent gets one narrow write grant to, instead of access to each other's storage + generic send_handoff/check_handoffs tools (truesight_autopilot#302), pull-based so a network-isolated instance (Bionpact) needs zero inbound access. Deployed to both Sophia and Bionpact; full 5-point UAT run live on both boxes (bidirectional delivery, scope-holding, filename-prefix routing isolation) — all passed.
